calculation_or_source: Old 150M USD revolver with 75M USD L/C limit
what_it_says: Before the July reset, Sterling had a specific 75M USD letter-of-credit limit.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not disclose actual letters of credit outstanding.
next_source: Next 10-Q liquidity table or debt footnote.

what_it_says: Sterling had no outstanding borrowings under the old revolving credit facility at June 30 2026.
what_it_does_not_say: No revolver borrowing does not mean no letters of credit or no surety exposure.
next_source: Separate L/C outstanding and surety exposure disclosures.

calculation_or_source: Company says it was assessed letter-of-credit fees on outstanding instruments
what_it_says: The filing implies there were outstanding instruments subject to fees.
what_it_does_not_say: The filing does not provide a dollar amount of L/C outstanding.
next_source: Debt note with L/C outstanding amount or bank facility availability table.

what_it_says: The new facility has 600M USD of L/C capacity.

calculation_or_source: 600M USD new L/C sublimit divided by 75M USD old L/C limit
what_it_says: L/C capacity increased 8.0x after the July 2026 reset.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not prove Sterling needed or used the full increase.
next_source: Post-reset availability and L/C usage table.

calculation_or_source: 600M USD L/C sublimit divided by 1.5B USD revolver
what_it_says: L/C capacity equals 40% of the revolver, so guarantee support is a core feature of the wrapper.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not identify beneficiaries, projects, or actual utilization.
next_source: Letter-of-credit schedule or borrowing-base availability table.

what_it_says: The agreement defines L/C Obligations as undrawn face amounts of outstanding letters of credit plus unpaid reimbursement obligations.
what_it_does_not_say: The definition is mechanics, not a usage number.

what_it_says: If cash collateralization is required, the collateral amount is 103% of aggregate L/C obligations unless a greater amount is required.
what_it_does_not_say: This is a stress/default/remedy mechanic, not normal-course usage.
next_source: Events that trigger cash collateralization and actual L/C balance.

value: surety bid appeal indemnity performance payment bonds
what_it_says: The credit agreement explicitly recognizes surety, bid, appeal, indemnity, performance, payment, and similar bonding arrangements.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not quantify bonded backlog or surety capacity.
next_source: Surety agreement and bonded backlog schedule.

metric: Letters of credit and surety bonds included in indebtedness definition
calculation_or_source: Indebtedness definition includes L/Cs, demand guarantees, surety bonds, performance bonds, and similar instruments
what_it_says: The covenant framework treats L/Cs and surety/performance-type instruments as relevant contingent obligations.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not say the full face amount is currently outstanding or covenant-binding in the same way as funded debt.
next_source: Formal covenant calculations and compliance certificate.

what_it_says: Transportation bidders generally must post bid bonds equal to 5% to 10% of the bid amount.
what_it_does_not_say: This is a general business requirement, not a contract-specific balance.

what_it_says: After award, some contracts require performance and payment bonds for up to 100% of construction cost.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not mean every backlog dollar is bonded or that every bond becomes a loss exposure.

what_it_says: Some maintenance bonds are generally 1% of contract amount for one to two years.
what_it_does_not_say: This is a requirement range, not actual maintenance-bond outstanding amount.
next_source: Maintenance-bond schedule or surety exposure table.

value: Travelers Casualty and Surety Company of America
what_it_says: Sterling obtains bonding primarily through Travelers.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not disclose surety capacity, bond face amount, or project names.
next_source: Travelers bonding agreement or surety capacity disclosure.

what_it_says: Sterling indemnifies Travelers and grants Travelers a security interest in accounts receivable and contract rights for issued bonds.
what_it_does_not_say: This is surety-support collateral, not a bank borrowing-base valuation or project funding proof.
next_source: Surety collateral terms and outstanding bond exposure.

value: cost to complete less remaining amounts to be billed
what_it_says: On certain projects, Sterling issues performance guarantees measured against remaining cost to complete and remaining billings.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not quantify aggregate guarantee exposure or expected loss.
next_source: Project-level guarantee schedule and reserve movement.

what_it_does_not_say: We cannot claim the 600M USD L/C sublimit is used, necessary, or tied to a specific backlog amount.

what_it_says: The current public source set explains bonding requirements and identifies Travelers but does not disclose bonded backlog amount.
what_it_does_not_say: We cannot say what share of backlog is bonded or surety-supported.
